# Evoly

> Evoly is an online ticketing platform for event organisers (associations, theatres, concerts, parties, galas, sports clubs, conferences). Organisers create an event and start selling tickets in about 60 seconds. Pricing is transparent: free tickets carry no commission; paid tickets carry a commission of 0.29 € + 2 % per ticket, capped at 2.50 € on the Free plan and 1 € on Pro (29 € per month), excluding payment fees (Stripe, charged at cost with no markup). Buyers always pay exactly the displayed price: fees are never added at checkout.

Evoly - billetterie en ligne : créez votre événement en 60 secondes ; prix affiché, prix payé ; commission de 0,29 € + 2 % plafonnée (2,50 € en Free, 1 € en Pro), hors frais de paiement ; billets gratuits sans commission.

## Key facts
- Buyers pay in one tap with Apple Pay, Google Pay, cards, PayPal, Klarna and local payment methods; payouts go directly to the organiser's own Stripe account.
- Price helper: organisers can enter what they want to receive per ticket and the attendee price is calculated for them (commission and payment fees included); or they enter the attendee price and see what they receive.
- Fan-to-fan resale with a shareable link, capped at face value.
- Assigned seating (Pro): visual seating plan editor with templates (theatre, hall, gala, church, cabaret, conference, arena, football stadium), best seats chosen automatically, "book next to my friends" link.
- E-tickets with QR codes, Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes, free scanner app for volunteers (works offline).
- Live sales statistics, promo codes, dynamic pricing tiers (Pro), email campaigns (Pro), custom domains and branding (Pro), team roles (Pro).
- Website in French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese and Dutch (https://evoly.me/en/, /es/, /de/, /it/, /pt/, /nl/); organiser app and ticket pages in French and English. GDPR-compliant, data hosted in the European Union.
